tableLines.line: 📖 LEARNED: Gossip Network (Level 1). You hear things. People tell you things. You remember who told you what.
The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Vikram speaks at Stonebridge's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
✦ Nadia has found something — Everybody's Friend. Days of silver_tongue and gossip_network side by side, and now they move as one. (everybodys_friend: villager synergy discovered)
★ Deeper knowledge: Maypop. Parts: ripe fruit only (wrinkled, yellow, fragrant). Unripe = bitter and nauseating. (Yield +50%). Use unlocked: food: ripe wrinkled fruit — sweet-tart pulp.
You accept Stonebridge's food — 1,757 kcal on the road, 2 day-parts out. Aisha clasps your runner's shoulder. "That's what the fire network is FOR." (Trust +4.)
